preprocessing.degradation_source: new synthetic LR from selected HR crop for BOTH HQ and REDS; supplied REDS LQ is not used
preprocessing.window: one fixed maximum-span start per HQ source across all six conditions; REDS starts at zero
preprocessing.native_VAE_temporal_cache: retained within encode/decode; do not encode frames independently

metrics.spatial_pixel_contract: full float32 RGB reconstruction and HR in [0,1]; no q/255 for spatial metrics
metrics.rgb: vsr.evaluation.rgb_metrics; per-frame RGB PSNR/SSIM, zero border shave
metrics.lpips: lpips==0.1.4; AlexNet v0.1; CPU; all original frames
metrics.temporal: existing TecoGAN tLP/tLP100/tOF Farneback; cutfr=2; official central crop; documented uint8 conversion
metrics.training_seed_statistics: not applicable: frozen deterministic VAE, no trained arms and no sampler seeds
pending: a separately specified metric named tLPIPS

notes.T1_1_remains_partial: E*warp/tLPIPS definitions and full-resolution tiling comparison are pending; crop full scope is 58 cases, not complete Stage 1
notes.DOVE_not_implemented: raft_rgb255 uses original raft-things.pth, half-resolution inputs, RAFT iters20, forward/backward+motion-boundary masks and CUDA Resample2d; adapter minimum frame 256x256. Existing torchvision C_T_SKHT_V2 weights and 128x224 audit crops do not match. No downloads/installations performed.
notes.full_resolution_plan: Separate future scope: REDS000 T9 stride1 native720x1280, raw untiled encode versus native enable_tiling(256x448,strides192x384), both decoded with identical untiled decoder; log OOM and stop without fallback.
notes.no_stage2_authorization: Continuing Stages0/1 does not settle D1–D4.

reproducibility.verified_probe: strict_determinism_probe: identical backward and 3-update same-state trajectories on thisGPU; no cross-hardware claim
